Accumulated behavioural rules / closed-loop framework (authors' own, unnamed, no version, not released). Instruction file following AGENTS.md / rules-file conventions. No SDD framework

Shared version-controlled Markdown instruction file (e.g. AGENTS.md) with five sections: behavioural rules, code standards, self-review checklist, anti-patterns, workflow rules; implicit rule schema (ID, category, trigger origin, scope, constraint, rationale, checklist map, date, traced-to review comment); personal rules file; session handoff file and task log; custom agent definitions, skills, knowledge documents with freshness dates; validation scripts

Loop: 1 agent generates/modifies code; 2 agent runs self-review checklist; 3 human reviewer gives feedback; 4 each accepted comment describing a generalisable mistake codified as a rule (or existing rule refined); 5 updated file loaded in all later sessions. Human code review of every change (source of rules); engineer decides whether a comment is a class of mistake; rule changes go through pull-request review; periodic review of the file for redundancy; conflicts resolved by the team
